AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0_.text: Apple Inc. reported total consolidated net sales of $383,285 million ($383.28B) with gross profit of $169,148 million, representing an overall gross margin of 44.1%.

metadata.section: Section 1: Executive Financial Performance and Income Statement Summary

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1_.text: Product net sales (iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables) generated $298,085 million, while Services revenue (App Store, Apple Music, iCloud, ApplePay) reached an all-time record of $85,200 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Executive Financial Performance and Income Statement Summary

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2_.text: Total operating expenses were $54,847 million, comprising $29,915 million in Research & Development (R&D) and $24,932 million in SG&A. Consolidated operating income stood at $114,301 million, yielding net income of $96,995 million ($6.13 diluted EPS).

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Working Capital and Liquidity Disclosures

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3_.text: Total assets stood at $352,583 million. Current assets included $29,965 million in Cash and cash equivalents, $31,590 million in Marketable securities, $29,508 million in Accounts receivable, and $6,331 million in Inventories.

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Working Capital and Liquidity Disclosures

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c4_.text: Current liabilities totaled $145,308 million, including $62,610 million in Accounts payable and $7,995 million in Deferred revenue. Non-current liabilities included $95,281 million in Long-term term debt. Total shareholders equity stood at $62,146 million.

metadata.section: Section 3: Critical Accounting Policies & Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c5_.text: Total shareholders equity stood at $62,146 million. Revenue is recognized when control of promised goods or services is transferred to customers.

metadata.section: Section 3: Critical Accounting Policies & Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c6_.text: Under ASC 606, hardware sales with bundled software updates are accounted for as multiple performance obligations with transaction prices allocated on a relative standalone selling price (SSP) basis. R&D costs are expensed as incurred.

metadata.section: Section 3: Critical Accounting Policies & Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

AAPL_Apple_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c7_.text: R&D costs are expensed as incurred. Inventories are stated at the lower of cost or net realizable value (NRV) using the first-in, first-out (FIFO) method.

metadata.section: Section 3: Critical Accounting Policies & Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0.text: Amazon reported net sales of $574,785 million ($574.79B), an increase of 12% year-over-year. North America segment sales were $352,828 million with operating income of $14,877 million. International segment contributed $131,200 million in net sales.

metadata.section: Section 1: Consolidated Revenue, AWS Segment and Operating Margins

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1.text: International segment contributed $131,200 million in net sales. Amazon Web Services (AWS) delivered $90,757 million in revenue with an operating margin of 27.1% ($24,631 million in AWS operating income), remaining the primary profit engine.

metadata.section: Section 1: Consolidated Revenue, AWS Segment and Operating Margins

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2.text: Consolidated worldwide operating income reached $36,852 million, yielding net income of $30,425 million ($2.90 diluted EPS). Operating cash flow grew 82% to $84,946 million.

metadata.section: Section 2: Cash Flow Generation, Fulfillment Infrastructure and Capital Leases

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3.text: Operating cash flow grew 82% to $84,946 million. Free cash flow swung positive to $36,810 million compared to negative $11,595 million in the prior period. Total assets stood at $527,854 million.

metadata.section: Section 2: Cash Flow Generation, Fulfillment Infrastructure and Capital Leases

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c4.text: Total assets stood at $527,854 million. Property and equipment net reached $203,788 million, reflecting investments in automated fulfillment centers and AWS server clusters. Lease liabilities under ASC 842 totaled $77,411 million (finance and operating leases for warehouse facilities and aircraft).

metadata.section: Section 3: Revenue Streams (ASC 606), Advertising and Depreciation Life

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c5.text: Retail product sales are recognized upon shipment or customer delivery. Third-party seller services and Amazon Advertising ($46,906 million revenue) are recognized as services are rendered or upon ad click impressions.

metadata.section: Section 3: Revenue Streams (ASC 606), Advertising and Depreciation Life

AMZN_Amazon_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c6.text: Useful lives for servers were extended to five years, reducing annual depreciation expense by approximately $4.4 billion.

metadata.section: Section 3: Revenue Streams (ASC 606), Advertising and Depreciation Life

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Microsoft Corporation achieved total annual revenue of $245,120 million ($245.12B), an increase of 16% year-over-year. Gross margin reached $168,590 million (68.8% gross margin).

metadata.section: Section 1: Segment Operations and Income Statement Breakdown

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Gross margin reached $168,590 million (68.8% gross margin). Intelligent Cloud segment (Azure, Windows Server, SQL Server) led revenue generation with $105,360 million, driven by 30% growth in Azure and cloud infrastructure services.

metadata.section: Section 1: Segment Operations and Income Statement Breakdown

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Productivity and Business Processes (Office 365, LinkedIn, Dynamics 365) generated $77,340 million, while More Personal Computing contributed $62,420 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Segment Operations and Income Statement Breakdown

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Total operating expenses were $58,850 million, leading to operating income of $109,430 million and net income of $88,140 million ($11.80 diluted EPS). Consolidated balance sheet total assets reached $512,160 million. Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $75,540 million.

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Intangibles and Capital Expenditure

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $75,540 million. Property, plant, and equipment (PPE) net expanded to $134,870 million, reflecting $44,500 million in capital expenditures primarily dedicated to AI cloud data center infrastructure.

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Intangibles and Capital Expenditure

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Goodwill and intangible assets stood at $118,920 million following the Activision Blizzard consolidation. Total liabilities were $243,690 million and Stockholders equity reached $268,470 million. Cloud services and software subscription licenses are recognized ratably over the contract term.

metadata.section: Section 3: Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Cloud Depreciation and Leases (ASC 842)

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Useful life of server and network equipment is depreciated straight-line over six years. Operating lease right-of-use assets of $32,100 million are recognized alongside corresponding lease liabilities in compliance with ASC 842.

metadata.section: Section 3: Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Cloud Depreciation and Leases (ASC 842)

MSFT_Microsoft_Financial_Report_2024.txt.text: Goodwill is tested annually for impairment during the fourth quarter or more frequently if triggering indicators arise.

metadata.section: Section 3: Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Cloud Depreciation and Leases (ASC 842)

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0.text: NVIDIA reported total annual revenue of $60,922 million ($60.92B), representing a 126% annual expansion driven by enterprise generative AI deployment. Compute & Networking segment generated $47,405 million, propelled by NVIDIA Hopper H100 and HGX platform deployments.

metadata.section: Section 1: Financial Results and Hyper-Scale AI Data Center Revenue

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1.text: Graphics segment (GeForce gaming and professional visualization) contributed $13,517 million. Gross margin expanded to 72.7% ($44,301 million gross profit). Total operating expenses were $11,329 million (R&D of $8,675 million).

metadata.section: Section 1: Financial Results and Hyper-Scale AI Data Center Revenue

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2.text: Total operating expenses were $11,329 million (R&D of $8,675 million). Operating income surged to $32,972 million (54.1% operating margin), resulting in consolidated net income of $29,760 million ($11.93 diluted EPS).

metadata.section: Section 2: Working Capital, Inventory Commitments and Balance Sheet

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3.text: Total balance sheet assets reached $65,728 million, up from $41,182 million in the prior fiscal period. Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $25,984 million. Inventories were $5,282 million, consisting of raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods.

metadata.section: Section 2: Working Capital, Inventory Commitments and Balance Sheet

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c4.text: Inventories were $5,282 million, consisting of raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods. Outstanding inventory purchase obligations and long-term supply agreements with semiconductor foundries (TSMC) totaled $16,100 million to secure wafer manufacturing capacity. Total stockholders equity expanded to $42,978 million.

metadata.section: Section 3: Accounting for Semiconductor Production, Warrants and Taxes

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c5.text: Total stockholders equity expanded to $42,978 million. Inventories are valued on a FIFO basis and written down to net realizable value for estimated excess and obsolete quantities based on demand forecasting.

metadata.section: Section 3: Accounting for Semiconductor Production, Warrants and Taxes

NVDA_NVIDIA_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c6.text: R&D expenditures for semiconductor integrated circuit masks and tape-outs are expensed as incurred until technological feasibility is proven. The effective tax rate was 12.0%, benefiting from foreign derived intangible income (FDII) deductions and federal research tax credits.

metadata.section: Section 3: Accounting for Semiconductor Production, Warrants and Taxes

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c0_.text: Tesla reported total annual revenues of $96,773 million ($96.77B), representing 19% growth year-over-year. Automotive segment revenue reached $82,419 million, including $1,790 million from zero-emission regulatory credits. Energy generation and storage (Megapack and Powerwall) grew 54% to $6,035 million.

metadata.section: Section 1: Automotive Revenues, Energy Generation & Operating Income

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c1_.text: Energy generation and storage (Megapack and Powerwall) grew 54% to $6,035 million. Services and other revenue contributed $8,319 million. Total automotive cost of revenues was $65,121 million, resulting in total gross profit of $17,660 million (18.2% gross margin).

metadata.section: Section 1: Automotive Revenues, Energy Generation & Operating Income

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c2_.text: Total operating expenses were $8,769 million (R&D $3,969 million), producing operating income of $8,891 million and net income of $14,997 million. Total balance sheet assets reached $106,618 million. Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $29,094 million.

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Battery Manufacturing Investments and Cash Reserves

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c3_.text: Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments totaled $29,094 million. Inventories stood at $13,626 million ($4,834 million raw materials and work-in-process; $7,402 million finished automotive vehicles).

metadata.section: Section 2: Balance Sheet, Battery Manufacturing Investments and Cash Reserves

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c4_.text: Net property, plant, and equipment reached $29,725 million, reflecting expansion across Gigafactory Texas, Berlin, and Shanghai. Total debt and finance leases excluding vehicle financing were $2,857 million. Total stockholders equity reached $62,634 million.

metadata.section: Section 3: Full Self-Driving (FSD) Deferred Revenue & Warranty Reserves

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c5_.text: Total stockholders equity reached $62,634 million. Automotive sales featuring Full Self-Driving (FSD) capabilities contain an unperformed software obligation. The deferred portion of FSD revenue is recognized as software feature updates are released over-the-air (OTA).

metadata.section: Section 3: Full Self-Driving (FSD) Deferred Revenue & Warranty Reserves

TSLA_Tesla_Financial_Report_2024.txt_c6_.text: Accrued warranty reserve liabilities are established at vehicle delivery based on historical repair claims and component failure modeling.
